description: A Black baseball player in a cream flannel uniform and cap, seen from the side and behind, strides toward a white base on a dirt infield with a brown leather glove stretched out, as if taking a throw at first. Behind him a packed grandstand of men in suits and fedoras and women in hats fills the stands, with a railing, brick wall and iron fencing. The dress and ballpark suggest the 1930s to 1940s. No letters, numbers, signs or team lettering, no frame, nothing gory.
